data.title: An Iran Truce May Be Near. That Doesn’t Make This War Any Smarter
data.description: According to media reports, the US and Iran are close to agreeing on a memorandum of understanding to end hostilities in the Persian Gulf. The terms that have been disclosed don’t seem likely to improve on the 2015 nuclear agreement the president abandoned in his first term, or even the accord that might’ve been reached before this conflict. Still, the administration’s aim now should be to make the best of a bad situation — and to learn something from this fiasco.
